title: Koi no Summer Fantasy: in Miyazaki Seagaia
native_title: 恋のサマーファンタジー ～ｉｎ 宮崎シーガイア～
overview: Koi no Summer Fantasy: in Miyazaki Seagaia is a dating simulation made to promote the Seagaia Ocean Dome. In it, players take idol Megumi Okina on a date through the eponymous water park, experiencing various attractions and making dialogue choices at pre-determined points in the story.
